title: Reverse in place vs by value
hints: Swap the first and last elements, then the second and second-to-last, and so on, stopping in the middle.
A `for` loop can declare and update two variables: `for i, j := 0, len(s)-1; i < j; i, j = i+1, j-1 { ... }`.
The body is one line: `s[i], s[j] = s[j], s[i]`. `ReversedArray` uses the exact same loop on `a`, then `return a`.
